summary: Draft implementation for the E2 timing block and ResearchPort admission/reverse-order frontend path only. Adds a standalone Verilator-compatible dma_research_e2_timing.sv, integrates it read-only into the existing observer D80..D8F local index window, adds ResearchPort policy inputs and ADMIT state to idma_reg64_frontend, passes parameters/ports through both wrapper modules, and adds directed tests. No top-level, UAPI, driver, or unrelated RTL changes are proposed. Old ResearchPort=0 behavior is preserved by parameter-gated sanitized internal signals. No build or simulation is claimed.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile and run the E2 timing directed test with Verilator 4.038.

Two variants:
  rtl        : CounterWidth=64
  rtl-small  : CounterWidth=8 for counter-overflow evidence
Simulation only; no board claim and no execution claim.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
RTL = ROOT / "cva6" / "corev_apu" / "fpga" / "src" / "dma_research_e2_timing.sv"
TB = ROOT / "tests" / "dma_research_e2_timing_test.cpp"

VARIANTS = (("rtl", []), ("rtl-small", ["-GCounterWidth=8"]))

for name, extra in VARIANTS:
    out = ROOT / "out" / "dma-research-e2-timing-20261003" / name
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    args = [
        "verilator", "--cc", "--exe", "--build", "-Wall", "-Wno-fatal",
        "--top-module", "dma_research_e2_timing", "--Mdir", str(out),
        str(RTL), str(TB),
    ] + extra
    with (out / "build.log").open("w") as log:
        result = subprocess.run(args, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        if result.returncode != 0:
            tail = (out / "build.log").read_text()[-4000:]
            print("BUILD FAILED (%s) tail:\n%s" % (name, tail))
            sys.exit(1)
    argv = [str(out / "Vdma_research_e2_timing")]
    if name == "rtl-small":
        argv.append("small")
    run = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if run.returncode != 0:
        print("RUN FAILED (%s):\n%s\n%s" % (name, run.stdout, run.stderr))
        sys.exit(1)
    print(run.stdout.strip())

print("PASS E2 timing builds (simulation only, no board claim)")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile and run the ResearchPort frontend directed test with Verilator 4.038.
Simulation only; no board claim and no execution claim.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
cva6 = root / "cva6"
out = root / "out/idma-research-frontend-20261003"
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

prim = cva6 / "corev_apu/register_interface/vendor/lowrisc_opentitan/src"
files = [
    cva6 / "vendor/pulp-platform/common_cells/include/common_cells/registers.svh",
    cva6 / "vendor/pulp-platform/axi/src/axi_pkg.sv",
    cva6 / "corev_apu/iDMA/src/idma_pkg.sv",
    cva6 / "corev_apu/iDMA/src/frontends/register_64bit/idma_reg64_frontend_reg_pkg.sv",
    prim / "prim_subreg_arb.sv",
    prim / "prim_subreg.sv",
    prim / "prim_subreg_ext.sv",
    cva6 / "corev_apu/iDMA/src/frontends/register_64bit/idma_reg64_frontend_reg_top.sv",
    cva6 / "corev_apu/iDMA/src/frontends/idma_transfer_id_gen.sv",
    cva6 / "corev_apu/iDMA/src/frontends/register_64bit/idma_reg64_frontend.sv",
    root / "tests/idma_research_frontend_top.sv",
    root / "tests/idma_research_frontend_test.cpp",
]

cmd = [
    "verilator", "--cc", "--exe", "--build", "-Wno-fatal",
    "--top-module", "idma_research_frontend_top",
    "--Mdir", str(out),
    "-I" + str(cva6 / "vendor/pulp-platform/common_cells/include"),
    "-I" + str(cva6 / "corev_apu/iDMA/src/include"),
] + list(map(str, files))

log_path = out / "build.log"
with log_path.open("w") as log:
    res = subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
if res.returncode != 0:
    print(log_path.read_text())
    raise SystemExit(res.returncode)

res = subprocess.run([str(out / "Vidma_research_frontend_top")])
if res.returncode != 0:
    raise SystemExit(res.returncode)
print("PASS ResearchPort frontend build and run")

python3 tests/test_idma_p4m_gap.py           # old P4M gap regression remains in place with new frontend ports tied to zero
assumptions: The local observer index window D80..D8F means local index 0x0D80..0x0D8F, matching the existing COST/Agg local windows.
V is DID10 and corresponds to observer lane 0, so issue_i[0]/done_i[0] are the V issue/done taps.
The frontend policy inputs are only meaningful for batch tasks; non-batch tasks ignore policy_enable/allow/abort and batch_reverse.
When ResearchPort=1 and policy_enable is high for a batch, the initial NEXT_ID reservation is accepted with rsp.ready=1 and then ADMIT gates the first backend VALID.
Legacy instantiations with ResearchPort=0 may leave the new inputs unconnected; internal ternary sanitization forces them to zero.
The 2D frontend remains unsupported for ResearchPort; the wrapper still exposes the parameter/ports but does not connect them in the 2D generate branch.
No top-level, UAPI, driver, or unrelated module changes are included; A-role top configuration is left for the later Codex/top integration step.
No command in this draft was executed; all test entries are proposals for the parent to run.
risks: The timing module uses phase_i only as a referenced integration signal; the actual gating is by legal acc_probe/acc_clear. If the parent requires phase_i to be functionally used, this needs a follow-up.
The ADMIT first-copy path changes the old NEXT_ID ready condition only when ResearchPort=1 and policy_enable=1. That path must be reviewed against the actual software-visible ready/ID contract.
Reverse order is latched in the batch register always_ff on batch issue; the parent should verify the exact issue edge matches the intended batch job issue definition.
Verilator 4.038 may emit PINMISSING warnings for legacy test tops that do not connect the new frontend inputs; -Wno-fatal is used in the proposed test entries.
Overflow coverage for the 64-bit timing counters is not exhaustively testable in normal simulation; only the CounterWidth=8 small variant is proposed for practical overflow evidence.
Observer D80..D8F read mux integration is checked only for magic/version in the old regression; the standalone timing test covers timing state behavior, not full observer E2 command sequencing.
